headline: As of 2026-09-29: 396,877 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 20 of 50 states, D+45.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 396,877 early/mail ballots cast so far across 20 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+45.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (183,217), New Jersey (72,156), Wisconsin (36,552).
